d: Standing on the windswept Salisbury Plain, the towering monoliths of Stonehenge have puzzled historians and scientists for thousands of years. In this high-stakes archaeological journey, join explorer Josh Gates as he investigates the secret quarry of Stonehenge to uncover how a prehistoric civilization quarried, shaped, and hauled multi-ton megaliths across immense distances without modern technology. Following ancient geological trails deep into western Wales, the expedition traces the ancient 140-mile route of Stonehenge bluestones from remote rock outcrops down to sacred ceremonial…
